duster.headline: Diesel-auto supply thin; 2022 Zen manual is the value play, TechRoad Auto best fits the auto+diesel brief.

shortlist.note: 2022 Zen diesel, R209990/72k km, +R24.3k under estimate — standout bargain, but manual.
2022 TechRoad Auto diesel, R249900/47k km, +R12.2k — matches auto+diesel brief; KIA franchise may lowball trade.
Cheapest diesel auto: 2019 Dynamique, R195000/88.5k km, +R5.7k; pre-2020, high km.

alerts.line: Durban Multifranchise — best trade-in odds for 2014 Duster 4x4

caddy.headline: Single listing: 2020 Crew Bus at R279990/76k km fits both caps — only option, so verify hard.

shortlist.note: Only listing: 2020 Crew Bus petrol, R279990/76k km; window-van Kombi config, within caps.

alerts.line: Sole listing — no comparables, inspect thoroughly

jimny.headline: Three 3-door options under caps; 2018 is cheapest, 2021 with 25k km freshest but near cap.

shortlist.note: Cheapest: 2018 1.3 older-gen, R234890/86k km, 3-door; R65k cap headroom for checks.
2021 GLX AllGrip, R295995/25.1k km, 3-door; freshest but R4k under cap.
2020 GLX AllGrip, R289890/78k km, 3-door; middle option, R10k headroom.

alerts.line: No dealer listed — likely private sale, verify

seltos.headline: Buyer's market: sub-R250k autos with big estUnder margins; 100k-km EX Auto cheapest, 2023 EX Auto cleanest.

shortlist.note: 2021 1.6 EX Auto, R210000/100000 km, +R37.7k — cheapest auto, exactly at km cap.
2023 1.6 EX Auto, R274990/44k km, +R26.9k — cleanest low-km auto.
2021 1.6 EX manual, R189900/93.8k km, +R44.9k — biggest bargain but manual; Bidvest takes trades.

alerts.line: R36.9k over estimate — skip despite diesel auto

creta.headline: Diesel autos cluster R250-280k; 2024 Premium Auto at R279999/40k km is the standout; new listing adds nothing.

shortlist.note: 2024 1.5 Premium Auto, R279999/40k km, +R26.4k — gen2, newest, low km; small dealer, verify.
2021 1.5D Executive Auto, R269990/60.1k km — gen2 diesel auto, matches brief; fairly priced.
2021 1.6D Executive Auto, R249990/98k km, +R15.7k — gen1 1.6D motor, high km.

alerts.line: New this run: 98.6k km, R7.4k over — skip

hr-v.headline: Thin market: two old-gen autos; the 2021 Comfort undercuts the 2020 Elegance by R49k — that's the move.

shortlist.note: 2021 Comfort CVT, 57,000 km, R249,990 — old gen: 448L boot, Magic Seats; cheapest.
2020 Elegance auto, 50,000 km, R298,900 — R49k premium for trim; weaker value.

corolla-cross.headline: Deep market, 14 CVT autos; two 2021 XS at R249,990 lead value — no hybrids under cap this run.

shortlist.note: 2021 XS, 36,300 km, R249,990 — estUnder +R26,690, market's best value.
2021 XS, 29,000 km, R249,999 — +R17,488 under; lower-km twin of the leader.
2024 Xi, 22,294 km, R259,990 — +R18,700; base spec, verify cheap near-new.

mg-zs.headline: Facelift-only market (443L boot qualifies); near-new Comforts from R249,900 — strong value, but resale unproven.

shortlist.note: 2026 Comfort, 9,906 km, R249,900 — +R17,809 under; cheapest, warranty into 2031.
2026 Luxury, 5,000 km, R269,900 — +R18,922 best estUnder; no dealer listed.
2026 Comfort, 14,700 km, R249,950 — +R8,681; CMH dealer backup.

alerts.line: No dealer shown — verify seller and warranty

haval-h6.headline: 2022 2.0T autos from R279,990; GWM/Haval franchised dealers are best Duster-trade candidates — skip the 2019 manual.

shortlist.note: 2022 2.0T Premium, 51,300 km, R279,990 — cheapest auto; Haval dealer, possible warranty remainder.
2022 2.0T Luxury, 66,100 km, R289,990 — higher trim; Chery franchise trade-in candidate.
2025 Premium, 40,000 km, R299,900 — newest, but 40k km in one year is heavy use.

peugeot-2008.headline: All gen2 6AT autos; the 2024 Active at R239,950 with 30,000 km beats the 2022 on freshness for R10k more.

shortlist.note: 2024 Active, 30,000 km, R239,950 — near-new, only R10k over cheapest.
2022 Allure, 55,000 km, R229,990 — cheapest; higher trim, check wet-belt history.
2025 Active, 32,000 km, R259,950 — freshest low-km option, R20k premium.

alerts.line: PureTech wet-belt — demand full service history

proton-x70.headline: Buyer's market: seven X70s under R285k, mostly CMH dealers; cheapest 2023 Standard sits ~R15k under model — move fast, test DCT in traffic.

shortlist.note: Cheapest 2023 at R209,899/68,100 km, ~R15k under model; CMH group handles Duster trade; warranty runs to ~2028.
2023 Executive AWD R239,900/67,000 km — same price as older 2022 unit; more kit, AWD, newer warranty clock.
Fallback Standard R229,900/70,000 km; R20k over Hillcrest car — grab only if Hillcrest unit sells.

alerts.line: Skip: 2022, 81,365 km, R249,990 — weakest value here.

discovery.headline: Only MG ZS clears the 430 L bar outright (443 L, all autos, in budget); Omoda C5 qualifies solely via 2025+ X Series (442 L).

shortlist.note: 443 L clears bar; 6/6 autos, R249.9k-299.9k, MG SA dealer network solid. Strong add.
Conditional add: only 2025+ X Series trims hit 442 L; standard 378 L fails. Filter trims.
